alembic.description: An argument list which is used as the Alembic command line (default: ['alembic'])

config.description: Name of the alembic configuration file (default: 'alembic.ini')

extra.description: Additional arguments consumed by custom env.py scripts

project_root.description: Path to the project root directory where your alembic configuration is stored.

section.description: The section within the configuration file to use for Alembic config (default: 'alembic')

block.description: Alembic database migration integration for Terraform.

alembic.description: Command used to execute alembic. By default, this is taken from the provider configuration.

environment.description: Environment variables to set when running the alembic command.

extra.description: Additional arguments consumed by custom env.py scripts

id.description: A unique ID for this resource used internally by terraform. Not intended for external use.

proxy_command.description: An argument list used to execute a proxy which allows direct communication with the database (e.g. cloud-sql-proxy)

proxy_sleep.description: Amount of time to sleep in order to allow the proxy to startup. Format is '[0-9]+(s|m|h|d|M|Y)' (default: '5s')

revision.description: The resulting revision after applying the upgrade.

tag.description: Arbitrary 'tag' name - can be used by custom env.py scripts.

target.description: Revision identifier. The target revision which we will stamp on the database.

block.description: Stamp a database with the given revision ID or current 'head'
